{
  "project_id": "P-UK-FreeBreakfastClubs",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Delay in obtaining budget confirmation and approval from HM Treasury could postpone programme start.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Engage Treasury early, secure provisional approval, build contingency timeline and alternative funding arrangements.",
      "evidence": "timely approval and budget confirmation from HM Treasury"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Insufficient availability of skilled staff and resources within DfE and the education sector may hinder delivery.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop recruitment plan, allocate training budget, use temporary contracts, monitor staffing levels.",
      "evidence": "availability of skilled staff and resources, in both DfE and the education sector"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "The internal CRM system may not be ready by the November 2025 MVP target, affecting school onboarding.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Adopt agile development, set clear milestones, consider interim manual processes, allocate additional IT resources.",
      "evidence": "develop a customer relationship management system internally, working towards a minimum-viable product from November 2025"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Schools may provide food that does not meet required school food standards, risking compliance breaches.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide clear guidance, conduct audits, offer training, enforce penalties for non‑compliance.",
      "evidence": "Food provided must be in line with school food standards"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Actual school participation and pupil attendance may be lower than forecast, reducing benefit‑cost ratio.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement outreach campaigns, monitor uptake early, adjust funding incentives, provide support to low‑take‑up schools.",
      "evidence": "gradual increase in school participation, supported by typical staffing patterns"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Physical space constraints in schools could limit ability to deliver 30‑minute supervised breakfast provision.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct space assessments, provide technical estate advisers, fund modest facility adaptations where needed.",
      "evidence": "technical estate advisers to test what schools can do to mitigate any space constraints"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "NSBP schools may experience gaps when transitioning to FBC in September 2026, disrupting provision.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Create transition plan, align timelines, provide interim support, monitor continuity of service.",
      "evidence": "It is anticipated that most schools on the NSBP will transfer to the FBC programme in September 2026"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Complexity and confusion around the mainstream funding model could deter schools from joining.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Simplify communication, produce clear guidance notes, run webinars, offer helpdesk support.",
      "evidence": "variation by disadvantage levels was deemed to be complicated... resulting in confusion"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "The call‑centre pilot for data collection may not achieve required performance, limiting data quality.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Pilot with clear KPIs, allocate sufficient staffing, have fallback manual data entry process.",
      "evidence": "call‑centre pilot to support data collection"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Local authorities may lack capacity to effectively support schools, affecting programme delivery.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide additional funding, training, and clear responsibilities to local authorities, monitor performance.",
      "evidence": "fund local authorities to support schools and the wider system to effectively deliver free breakfast clubs"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Delay or amendment to the Children’s Wellbeing and Schools Bill could postpone the mandatory duty.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Maintain liaison with legislative team, prepare interim guidance, adjust rollout schedule if needed.",
      "evidence": "Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill will place a duty on state‑funded schools"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Start‑up grant costs may exceed the £1,000 estimate, leading to budget overruns.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set up cost monitoring, allow contingency fund, review actual start‑up expenses early.",
      "evidence": "£1,000 start‑up grant to cover one‑off costs"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Evaluation may not deliver timely insights, limiting ability to adapt programme.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Define clear evaluation milestones, ensure independent commissioner has resources, integrate interim findings into management decisions.",
      "evidence": "evaluation will adopt an iterative, mixed‑methods approach... interim and final reporting to inform ongoing policy development"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Procurement of additional advisers under the education and children’s social care framework may be delayed, reducing support for complex schools.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Accelerate procurement timeline, use fast‑track procedures, maintain a shortlist of pre‑qualified suppliers.",
      "evidence": "procurement process to increase the number of advisers supporting schools through the educational and children's social care framework"
    }
  ]
}
